board_convention: 1-39 counted from the RIGHT gutter (right-hander's convention), read at the last on-lane frames before the pins
camera: Meta glasses, first person: looks down at the ball until release, then the head comes up and rolls; every frame moves
release_uncertain: +-1: ball low in frame with the hand over it at 411, fingers still crossing it at 412, free at 413 (cuts.json said 411)
pin_hit_uncertain: +-2: RIGHT GUTTER BALL, no pin contact; ball reaches the pin-deck front in the right gutter at 462-464, camera whips/blurs from 464

lane.description: Centre lane of the frame after release (pins at x~740-805, y~990-1045 at frame 459); image is strongly rolled (~8 deg at the rack, more mid-roll) as the head turns right. Frame 422 is heavily motion-blurred, its quad is +-10 px.

board_reads.note: Pin-spacing ruler not usable: the ball leaves the lane ~25 m before the pins, so the rack's px/in does not apply at the ball row; the ball's own 8.5 in diameter was used as the second ruler. Uncertainty floored at 0.5 (half-spread 0.15).

ball_uncertain.412: hand/fingers overlap the ball; centre +-10 px
ball_uncertain.435: ball at the gutter lip, partly darkened
ball_uncertain.461: in the gutter, blur; centre +-4 px
ball_uncertain.462: in the gutter, blur; centre +-4 px

truth_method: Ball centres/radii read by eye on 3x gridded crops of the source frames (candidates from yolo11n_bowling.pt at conf 0.1 and a purple-HSV blob chain, each shown as a circle on the crop and corrected where it disagreed); lane edges read on gridded row strips at 1-6x; board read two ways at the last on-lane frames (edge profile at the ball row, plus a pin-column or ball-diameter ruler).
gutter_entry: ball hugs the right edge ~10 px inside from 437 to 440, centre crosses the edge 441-442, in the right gutter from 443
